title: Full-Stack Engineer
blurb: Frontend, backend, data, deployment and AI features tied together: the web platform, HTML/CSS, TypeScript, React and Next.js, APIs, Node, Postgres and MongoDB, auth, caching and queues, testing, DevOps, observability and system design.
audience: Developers aiming for full-stack product engineering roles

nodes.title: HTTP, DNS and TLS
nodes.summary: Methods, status codes, headers, cookies and the full path from typing a URL to getting a response. Both halves of the stack meet here, so every debugging session starts with it.
checklist: Walk through what happens when you type a URL: DNS lookup, TCP or QUIC, TLS, request, response, render
Explain the meaning of GET, POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE, and which are safe and idempotent
Pick the right status code for created, no content, bad input, unauthorised, forbidden, conflict and rate limited
Explain recursive vs authoritative DNS resolvers, TTLs and why DNS changes take time to propagate
Describe what a TLS certificate proves and what the handshake negotiates
Debug a request end to end with curl -v and the browser network panel

links.title: Cloudflare: what happens in a TLS handshake

nodes.title: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
nodes.summary: How connections, multiplexing, head-of-line blocking and QUIC change latency, and what that means for bundling, CDNs and APIs.
checklist: Explain head-of-line blocking in HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 over TCP and why HTTP/3 over QUIC avoids the TCP part
Describe HTTP/2 multiplexing, header compression (HPACK) and why domain sharding is now an anti-pattern
Explain keep-alive, connection reuse and connection pooling on the server side
Compare WebSockets, server-sent events and long polling for pushing data to the browser
Explain CORS: simple vs preflighted requests and which response headers make them pass
Read the protocol column in the network panel and explain a waterfall

nodes.title: HTTP caching and CDNs
nodes.summary: Cache-Control, ETags and CDNs: the cheapest way to make a full-stack app fast, and the easiest way to serve stale or private data by accident.
checklist: Explain max-age, s-maxage, no-cache, no-store, private and immutable in Cache-Control
Explain revalidation with ETag / If-None-Match and Last-Modified, and when a 304 is returned
Use stale-while-revalidate and explain what the user sees during revalidation
Design a caching policy for hashed static assets vs HTML vs authenticated API responses
Explain CDN cache keys, Vary, purging and why a cached Set-Cookie is a security bug

links.title: web.dev: prevent unnecessary network requests with the HTTP cache

nodes.title: Git and the command line
nodes.summary: Branching, rebasing, conflict resolution and shell basics. Every team expects you to work cleanly in a shared repository from day one.
checklist: Explain commits, branches and HEAD as pointers in the commit graph
Choose between merge and rebase, and explain why you never rebase shared history
Resolve a merge conflict and recover lost work with git reflog
Use interactive rebase to squash and reword commits before a PR
Find the commit that introduced a bug with git bisect
Write small commits with clear messages and keep PRs reviewable

links.title: MIT: the missing semester of your CS education

nodes.title: Linux basics
nodes.summary: Processes, permissions, environment variables, logs and SSH. Enough to debug a server or a container when the dashboard is not telling you why.
checklist: Inspect processes and ports with ps, top and lsof or ss
Explain file permissions, users and why containers should not run as root
Use environment variables, exit codes, pipes and redirection in a shell script
Tail and grep logs and follow a systemd or container log stream
Connect with SSH keys and copy files with scp or rsync

links.title: MIT missing semester: shell tools and scripting

nodes.title: Semantic HTML
nodes.summary: Landmarks, headings, buttons vs links and native form controls. The right element gives you keyboard support, accessibility and SEO for free.
checklist: Structure a page with header, nav, main, article, aside and footer landmarks and a logical heading order
Explain when to use a button vs a link, and why a clickable div is a bug
Build an accessible form with labels, fieldset and legend, and native validation attributes
Use native dialog, details and summary instead of hand-rolled widgets where they fit
Explain how the accessibility tree is derived from the DOM

nodes.title: Box model, cascade and layout
nodes.summary: The box model, specificity and the cascade, then Flexbox and Grid, so you can build any screen without fighting the browser.
checklist: Explain the box model, box-sizing and margin collapse
Resolve a specificity conflict and explain cascade order, inheritance and !important
Explain what creates a stacking context and why a z-index of 9999 can still lose
Choose Flexbox for one-dimensional layout and Grid for two-dimensional layout
Build a holy-grail layout with Grid template areas
Centre anything vertically and horizontally three different ways

links.title: Josh Comeau: an interactive guide to Flexbox
Josh Comeau: an interactive guide to CSS Grid
Josh Comeau: what the heck, z-index

nodes.title: Responsive design
nodes.summary: Fluid layouts, media queries, container queries and responsive images, so one codebase works from a small phone to a wide monitor.
checklist: Explain the viewport meta tag and mobile-first media queries
Use relative units (rem, em, %, vw, dvh) and clamp() for fluid typography
Explain container queries and when they beat media queries for components
Serve responsive images with srcset, sizes and the picture element
Test layouts at real breakpoints and with 200% browser zoom

nodes.title: Modern CSS
nodes.summary: Custom properties, :has(), cascade layers, nesting and logical properties: features now in every evergreen browser that replace a lot of JavaScript and preprocessor code.
checklist: Use custom properties for theming, including a dark mode switch
Explain :has() and write a parent selector that styles a card when it contains an image
Organise styles with @layer and explain how layers change the cascade
Use native CSS nesting and logical properties such as margin-inline
Check browser support with Baseline before shipping a new feature

nodes.title: Accessibility
nodes.summary: Semantic HTML, keyboard support, focus management, ARIA and contrast. Many full-stack loops ask you to make a component accessible, and it is a legal requirement in many markets.
checklist: Explain the four WCAG principles (perceivable, operable, understandable, robust) and what level AA means
Make every interactive element keyboard reachable with a visible focus style
Apply the first rule of ARIA and fix a component that misuses role or aria-label
Manage focus when a modal opens and closes and when a route changes
Announce async updates with an aria-live region
Audit a page with axe and a screen reader (VoiceOver or NVDA)

nodes.title: How the browser renders
nodes.summary: DOM, CSSOM, layout, paint and compositing, and what blocks rendering. The base for every performance answer.
checklist: Describe the critical rendering path from HTML bytes to pixels
Explain which resources are render-blocking and how defer, async and preload change that
Explain layout, paint and composite, and which CSS properties trigger each
Spot and fix layout thrashing caused by reading and writing layout in a loop
Record and read a Performance panel trace

links.title: Chrome: inside look at a modern web browser

nodes.title: JavaScript fundamentals
nodes.summary: Closures, this, prototypes, promises and async/await. Used on both client and server and probed in almost every frontend round.
checklist: Explain closures and use one to build once() and memoize()
State the four this binding rules and how arrow functions differ
Explain the prototype chain and what class syntax compiles to
Explain promise states, chaining and error propagation, and write Promise.all from scratch
Implement debounce and throttle from scratch
Explain ES modules vs CommonJS and why import is hoisted

links.title: MDN: inheritance and the prototype chain

nodes.title: The event loop
nodes.summary: Tasks, microtasks and rendering steps, and why blocking the loop freezes a browser tab or a Node server alike.
checklist: Explain the call stack, task queue and microtask queue and their order
Predict the output of a snippet mixing setTimeout, promises and queueMicrotask
Explain where requestAnimationFrame and rendering fit in a loop iteration
Break a long task into chunks so the page stays responsive
Explain why an infinite microtask chain starves rendering

Jake Archibald: In The Loop (JSConf talk)

nodes.title: TypeScript end to end

Explain unknown vs any vs never and when each is correct

Share request and response types between server and client from one source
Turn on strict mode and explain what strictNullChecks and noUncheckedIndexedAccess catch

nodes.title: Generics and advanced types

checklist: Write a generic function with a constraint and explain inference at the call site
Use Partial, Pick, Omit, Record, ReturnType and Awaited correctly
Write a mapped type with key remapping and a conditional type with infer
Write a user-defined type guard and an assertion function
Explain satisfies vs a type annotation and when as const helps

nodes.title: How React renders
nodes.summary: Render vs commit, reconciliation, keys and what triggers a re-render. Most React bugs and performance questions come back to this.
checklist: Explain the render phase vs the commit phase
List what causes a component to re-render (state, parent render, context) and what does not
Explain why key matters when reordering a list and what an index key breaks
Explain how state is preserved or reset based on position in the tree

nodes.title: Hooks and effects

Decide when an effect is needed and when derived state or an event handler is better

Dan Abramov: a complete guide to useEffect

Mark a non-urgent update with startTransition and explain what stays interactive
Use useDeferredValue to keep a search input responsive over a slow list
Explain how Suspense streams HTML on the server
Pair Suspense with error boundaries for failed loads

nodes.title: React performance
nodes.summary: Memoisation, the React Compiler, transitions and virtualisation. Measure first, then fix the slow render you actually found.
checklist: Profile a slow interaction with the React DevTools profiler
Explain when memo, useMemo and useCallback help and when they only add cost
Explain what the React Compiler memoises automatically
Virtualise a long list and explain the trade-offs (find-in-page, accessibility)

Use dynamic segments, route groups and parallel or intercepting routes

Explain proxy.ts (formerly middleware) and why it is only an optimistic check

nodes.title: React Server Components

Explain which props can cross the boundary (serialisable values only)

Explain the RSC payload and how it differs from SSR HTML

Show pending and error state with useActionState and useFormStatus

nodes.title: Next.js data and caching

Explain time-based revalidation vs on-demand revalidation with tags
Explain which routes are static vs dynamic and what makes a route dynamic
